messages:

Subject: BayTech 2026 Sponsorship Package + agreement (first pass)

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for taking the time on Monday. Attached is the sponsorship agreement (v3) and the exhibitor map for BayTech 2026. Highlights from the package we discussed:

- Partner Theater: 30-minute session in Partner Theater A (midday)
- Exhibit: 10x10 inline booth with one 6ft table and two chairs (near Hall B entrance)
- Branding: logo on conference website, sponsor page, and Stage B backdrop (small logo tier)
- Tickets: 100 comps + 500 lead credits for lead retrieval rental (one scanner)
- Marketing: featured mention in one pre-event email blast and inclusion on sponsor landing page
- Logistics: AV available on a la carte basis, shipping to show warehouse (address in exhibit manual)

I've attached the contract for signature. Please review and let us know any edits by EOD Friday 22 May so we can finalize for printing and exhibitor materials.

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Sophie Reynolds <sophie@baytechconf.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BayTech 2026 Sponsorship Package + agreement (first pass)

Thanks Sophie — quick read-through from our side. Appreciate the fast turnaround. A few items we need to address before we can sign:

1) Partner Theater timing and format
   - We prefer a 45-minute technical workshop (30min presentation + 15min live Q&A) rather than a straight 30-minute slot. Is there flexibility to extend to 45? Alternatively, a 30+15 fireside could work but we'd like hands-on time.

2) Branding / logo placement
   - Can you confirm the logo tier placement on the main stage backdrop versus the expo hall signage? We are prepared to pay for an upgraded logo placement to be prominent on the main stage (not just small tier) — please provide costs.

3) Exclusive categories
   - We discussed being the featured AI sponsor for the expo track. Can BayTech confirm we will not have another AI vendor in the partner theater or sponsor email blast (one AI feature slot)?

4) Attendee data / list
   - We need a pre-event attendee list at least 2 weeks out (hashed or email list opt-in). Please confirm what PII is shareable and whether BayTech can provide a hashed list or an opt-in CSV.

5) AV and booth requirements
   - Please confirm that basic AV (LCD screen + single laptop feed + mic) is included for the workshop without an additional line-item charge. Also confirm the load-in times and power availability.

6) Logistics and swag
   - We'll need to ship approx. 500 swag units. Confirm warehouse address and whether BayTech provides freight handling or we arrange our courier.

Ben, can you take a look at the indemnity and data-sharing section and flag anything that needs legal redline?

If Sophie can send a revised agreement with those items addressed, we can aim to sign next week.

Thanks — cc'ing Vanessa for partner ops and Marissa for on-site marketing.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Events — Redwood Inference
tessa_morgan@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0198

From: Sophie Reynolds <sophie@baytechconf.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Daniel Park <dpark@eventops.io>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BayTech 2026 Sponsorship Package + agreement (first pass)

Tessa — thanks for the detailed points. Short answers below and next steps: 

1) Partner Theater: we can convert the 30 into a 45-minute workshop in Partner Theater A at no additional charge, slots permitting. We'll hold the midday slot you requested while we confirm the final schedule.

2) Branding/Logo: we can offer a Stage Backdrop upgrade to "Featured Logo" tier for an additional $4,500. That includes larger placement on Stage B backdrop and priority on printed materials.

3) Exclusivity: we don't offer full exclusives, but we can guarantee you as the "Featured AI Sponsor" in one targeted pre-event email and grant a featured callout on the sponsor landing page (no other AI logos in that specific email). Cannot restrict partner theater participants but will avoid scheduling direct competitors in adjacent partner theater sessions where possible.

4) Attendee data: for compliance we can provide a pre-event hashed list (SHA256 hashed emails) and an opt-in CSV of attendees who consented to share contact info. Raw PII cannot be shared.

5) AV & Booth: basic AV (screen + laptop feed + lav + wired mic) is included for partner theater workshops. Power and 20A plug-in confirmed at booth. Load-in times: Tues 06:00–10:00 local.

6) Shipping: we offer warehouse drayage (incoming + outbound) at standard rates; shipping address and manual are attached.

I've updated the agreement with the workshop and branding upgrade option and sent v4 (redline). See attached: BayTech_Sponsorship_Agreement_v4_redline.pdf, BayTech_Logo_Guidelines.pdf. If you and Ben approve, I'll push the DocuSign link for signatures.

Attachments: [attachment: BayTech_Sponsorship_Agreement_v4_redline.pdf (PDF, 312 KB)], [attachment: BayTech_Logo_Guidelines.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

Proposed timeline:
- Thu 21 May: BayTech sends v4 (done)
- Fri 22 May: Redwood legal review (Ben)
- Mon 25 May: final DocuSign out

Regards,
Sophie Reynolds
Partnerships Manager — BayTech Conference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com

Quick legal redlines after reviewing v4: 
- Section 7 (Indemnity): narrow to exclude indirect/consequential damages and add mutual indemnity carve-out for IP claims.
- Section 12 (Data Sharing): require hashed list only; add language that BayTech will not use data provided for third-party marketing without consent. Add data retention period of 90 days post-event.
- Section 15 (Cancellation): add a clause allowing refund/credit if BayTech materially changes deliverables (e.g., removing Partner Theater).

I attached a short redline with track changes. Nothing blocking — mostly carve-outs and a 90-day retention addition. Sophie — can you accept those changes or propose language?

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

- Redwood marketing (Marissa): will prepare high-res logos and 2x variant lockups (white and color) once DocuSign is out. Marissa, I'll assign drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bxyz-baytech-assets
- Redwood events ops (Vanessa): coordinate shipment (approx 500 swag units) and confirm drayage costs. We'll book courier once BayTech confirms handling rates.

Thanks — looking forward to BayTech.
